title: Navimower 0.4.5-beta8

## Stable vendor trail backbone with a short live MQTT tail

- Keep retained vendor trail geometry as the authoritative current-cycle backbone whenever a matching vendor row exists for the active zone.
- Treat MQTT only as the live extension ahead of the newest vendor point.
- If the newest vendor point cannot be anchored into the MQTT session history, fail closed and publish **no MQTT fallback trail** instead of exposing the full Home Assistant-built session trail over the vendor footprint.
- Cap a successfully matched live MQTT tail to the newest **8 m** and keep only the newest continuous segment.
- Export tail diagnostics including `tail_limit_m` and whether an unmatched MQTT trail was suppressed.
- Preserve existing MQTT/session fallback behavior for zones where vendor retained geometry is not available.

## Regression coverage

- Verify unmatched vendor/MQTT geometry cannot resurrect the full session trail.
- Verify matched tails are limited to 8 m.
- Verify segment gaps are never bridged while trimming the live tail.

This beta is designed to pair with Navimower Map Card 0.3.7-beta4 for field testing of a stable vendor-rendered mowing footprint plus a short live MQTT tail.
